about: The registry of proper nouns of the legendarium that stand in English and their Dia-thìris forms (eras/NAMES.json). names: the forms every writer uses; the first mention in a chapter, section or annals entry takes the gloss (legendarium/glosses.py puts it after the name as a footnote or hover gloss, so gloss never repeats dt). ambiguous: cases that may be common nouns, with a proposed form, for the lead to decide; the build ignores them. Human personal names are not here and stay as written. Every dt is unchanged by rodais_engine.normalize() and passes check_agreement() word by word. status: existing = the legendarium, dictionary or map already gives the form; coined = made for this registry from the dictionary and the grammar. first: the first-attested annals event id.
